android.desc:
💣 MineCrack – Classic Minesweeper, Reimagined for Modern Devices. Completely 100% game free to play.

Test your logic, speed, and focus in this clean, modern take on the timeless puzzle classic. No ads, no distractions, no tracking — just pure deduction and brain-teasing fun. CHORDING SUPPORT – Tap on revealed numbers to quickly clear adjacent cells when flags match. Can be enabled/disabled in Settings.

🧩 GAME MODES

🎯 LEVEL MODE

30 progressive levels with carefully tuned difficulty curves

Grid sizes evolve from 5x5 up to 12x12

Mine count proportional to the area for balanced gameplay

Unlock the next level only by completing the current one

🏆 TOURNAMENT MODE (4 unique variants)

⚡ Speed Challenge: 5 minutes on the timer. Complete as many levels as you can before time runs out. One life only. Progress saved automatically.

🛡️ Survival Mode: No time limit, 3 lives. Each mine costs one life. Save & resume supported.

🏃 Marathon: 7 minutes with combo multiplier system. Each level completed increases your combo and multiplier (up to 5x). Progress saved automatically.

⏱️ Blitz Challenge: Start with 1 minute and 3 lives. Every completed level gives time bonuses (base + level bonus + time saved). Every 3 levels, earn an extra life. Save & resume supported.

🎮 CLASSIC MODE

Basic: 5x5 grid, 5 mines

Beginner: 9x9 grid, 10 mines

Intermediate: 16x16 grid, 40 mines

Expert: 16x30 grid, 99 mines

✨ FEATURES

✅ NO ADS. EVER. – No banners, no video ads. Just uninterrupted gameplay.

⚡ INSTANT LOADING – Optimized for all Android devices, from budget phones to flagship tablets.

🧠 CHORDING SUPPORT – Tap on revealed numbers to quickly clear adjacent cells when flags match. Can be enabled/disabled in Settings.

🎯 PRECISE CONTROLS – Tap to reveal cells, long-press to place flags. Toggle flag mode for faster play.

📶 WORKS OFFLINE – No internet connection required. Perfect for commuting or traveling.

📈 LEADERBOARDS – Scores organized by game mode: Level Mode, Classic Mode, and Tournament Mode (Speed, Survival, Marathon, Blitz).

💾 SMART SAVE & RESUME – All tournament modes save your full game state: board position, timer, lives, combo, multiplier, and score.

🎨 CUSTOMIZABLE SETTINGS – Adjust sound effects and reveal animation speed (Slow, Medium, Fast).

🚩 FLAG MODE – Toggle between flag placement and normal mode for precise marking.

🏁 SPEEDRUNNER FRIENDLY – Minimal, distraction-free UI. Perfect for chasing fast

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I'm a solo indie developer and I built Minecrack, a lightweight Minesweeper-style puzzle game for Android.

Classic gameplay  
 Multiple difficulty levels  
 Works offline  
 No login, no ads (just a clean experience)

The goal was to keep it simple, fast, and familiar — something to play quickly without distractions. I’d love feedback from anyone who’s a fan of logic games, UI minimalism, or retro-style mobile games.

Play Store link: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.vdm.minecrackpro

Thanks in advance for checking it out!
